cues.en: Hello. You found the portal. I'm your host, Eric Weinstein, and I think that today's must be the most unusual episode yet of a podcast that has been marked by almost regular unusual episodes.
cues.zh: 你好。你找到了入口。我是主持人 Eric Weinstein。我觉得今天这期，肯定是一档素来以“几乎定期的不寻常”著称的播客里，迄今为止最不寻常的一期。

cues.en: Now this is the first podcast that I'm recording at home. I don't really have a home recording studio, so we're really doing this from chicken wire and masking tape.
cues.zh: 现在这是我第一次在家录制播客。我其实没有家庭录音室，所以我们真的是用铁丝网和美纹纸胶带凑合着做。

cues.en: But I am sheltering in place because of the worldwide COVID pandemic,
cues.zh: 但我因为全球新冠疫情而居家避疫，

cues.en: and what we've been asked by the state of California and by the federal government is to shelter in place for an upcoming month because today is April 1.
cues.zh: 而加州州政府和联邦政府要求我们做的，是在接下来一个月里居家避疫，因为今天是4月1日。

cues.en: Now during a pandemic, I can assure you that no one is interested in April Fool's jokes. So the question is what to do with the April fools tradition in a situation in which nobody wants a prank.
cues.zh: 疫情期间，我可以保证，没人对愚人节玩笑感兴趣。所以问题是，在没人想要恶作剧的情况下，愚人节传统该怎么办。

cues.en: I thought that this was probably the best time to launch an idea that I've been playing with for years. And that idea is that it is dangerous to have a world in which we are afraid to talk about what we think is true.
cues.zh: 我觉得这大概正是提出我琢磨了好几年的一个想法的最佳时机。这个想法就是：如果在一个世界里，我们不敢谈论自己认为真实的东西，那是很危险的。

cues.en: When I think about what happened during the beginning of the COVID pandemic,
cues.zh: 回想新冠疫情暴发初期发生的事，

cues.en: I find that we were in general intimidated
cues.zh: 我发现我们普遍被吓住了，

cues.en: from sharing our fears about the virus.
cues.zh: 不敢分享对病毒的恐惧。

cues.en: We were told that if we wore masks that we were acting in a peculiar fashion. If we refused to shake hands, we were behaving in a strange and unpleasant social way.
cues.zh: 有人告诉我们，戴口罩是举止古怪；拒绝握手则是社交上奇怪又让人不舒服。

cues.en: We did not want to be alarmist. We did not want to be seen as Chicken Little.
cues.zh: 我们不想危言耸听，也不想被当成杞人忧天的人。

cues.en: And in fact, it was extremely important that we not be seen as xenophobic given that the outbreak was originating in Wuhan, China.
cues.zh: 事实上，鉴于疫情发源于中国武汉，不被视为排外极其重要。

cues.en: In fact, perhaps the most dangerous idea was that this outbreak might have been connected to some research being done in a lab, perhaps a bioweapons lab.
cues.zh: 事实上，也许最危险的想法是：这次疫情可能和某个实验室正在进行的研究有关，也许是生物武器实验室。

cues.en: We really don't know where this epidemic began. What is the ideology of something that is causing the entire world economy to effectively shut down?
cues.zh: 我们真的不知道这场疫情从何开始。一个正让整个世界经济实质停摆的东西，其意识形态究竟是什么？

cues.en: What I believe is that that silence has been deadly.
cues.zh: 我认为，那种沉默是致命的。

cues.en: We have many people who have now lost their lives because we did not feel free to exchange ideas, to think, and to talk. And in fact, many of the people who warned us first
cues.zh: 现在有很多人失去了生命，因为我们不能自由地交流想法、思考和谈论。而事实上，许多最早警告我们的人

cues.en: were the freest members of society, having been previously canceled
cues.zh: 恰恰是社会中最自由的成员，只不过此前已被“取消”

cues.en: by standard mainstream institutions
cues.zh: 被那些标准的主流机构

cues.en: and their associated media.
cues.zh: 以及与之相关的媒体。

cues.en: So what I thought would be important for an April Fools' Day that no one wants to actually participate in was to deal with an idea that maybe one day a year, we should all be free
cues.zh: 所以我觉得，对于一个没人真想参与的愚人节来说，重要的是探讨这样一个想法：也许一年里有一天，我们都该自由地

cues.en: to share crazy ideas that are going around
cues.zh: 分享那些在脑子里转来转去的疯狂想法

cues.en: between our ears and in our head. We're having conversations with ourselves wondering, is anyone else seeing the same thing that I'm seeing?
cues.zh: 它们就在我们两耳之间、在我们脑袋里。我们跟自己对话，琢磨着：有没有别人也看到我所看到的？

cues.en: But we are too afraid because the social stigma for actually believing in things, that maybe things are possible or perhaps there's a conspiracy somewhere.
cues.zh: 但我们太害怕了，因为真正相信某些事——也许事情真有可能，或者哪里存在阴谋——会招来社会污名。

cues.en: Perhaps we are ill prepared. For example,
cues.zh: 也许我们准备不足。例如，

cues.en: I believe that our current pandemic
cues.zh: 我认为我们当前的大流行病

cues.en: is exacerbated
cues.zh: 之所以加剧

cues.en: because our government and our readiness czars failed to stock adequate supplies
cues.zh: 是因为我们的政府和应急准备负责人未能储备充足的物资

cues.en: and that these supplies were called for in the academic literature for years. There was absolutely no excuse not to have personal protective
cues.zh: 而这些物资多年来一直见于学术文献的呼吁。完全没有理由不储备个人防护

cues.en: equipment stocked for doctors and nurses and hospitals, to say nothing, of all of the people who are in the front lines of treating patients sick with COVID.
cues.zh: 装备，供医生、护士和医院使用，更不用说所有在一线治疗新冠患者的人。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: currently, I don't believe that you can trust the World Health Organization.
cues.zh: 目前，我不认为你能信任世界卫生组织。

cues.en: Absolutely not. I don't think you can trust Surgeon General of The United States, and I absolutely don't think you can trust the CDC,
cues.zh: 绝对不是。我认为你不能信任美国卫生总监，我也绝对认为你不能信任CDC，

cues.en: because they are all covering for our inadequacy.
cues.zh: 因为他们都在掩盖我们的不足。

cues.en: This was a problem that we always knew was coming.
cues.zh: 这个问题我们早就知道会来。

cues.en: And we, at one point, had stocks, which apparently were depleted under previous administration and not restocked under this administration.
cues.zh: 而我们曾经有储备，但显然在上届政府期间被耗尽，本届政府也没有补充。

cues.en: In fact, our fear of dealing with a pervasive
cues.zh: 事实上，我们对应对普遍存在的

cues.en: institutional
cues.zh: 机构性

cues.en: incompetence
cues.zh: 无能

cues.en: has blinded us to the degradation in our society across all major institutions.
cues.zh: 的恐惧，已经让我们对全社会各大机构的退化视而不见。

cues.en: As I've discussed before on the program, I believe that this has a singular ideology.
cues.zh: 正如我此前在节目中所讨论的，我认为这背后有一种单一的意识形态。

cues.en: That is, that because of embedded growth obligations coming from the previous era of unsustainable
cues.zh: 也就是说，因为来自上一个不可持续时代的嵌入式增长义务——

cues.en: postwar growth from about 1945
cues.zh: 战后增长大约从1945年

cues.en: to nineteen seventy one, seventy three, something like that,
cues.zh: 到1971年、1973年左右，差不多这样——

cues.en: we built in expectations to our system that cannot currently be met.
cues.zh: 我们给系统设定了目前无法满足的预期。

cues.en: We will not have technology that follows the same breakneck pace of innovation.
cues.zh: 我们将不会拥有继续保持这种疯狂创新速度的技术。

cues.en: As a result,
cues.zh: 因此，

cues.en: we have a system whereby the heads of our organizations are forced to cover for their inadequacies because growth is built into the system that cannot be sustained.
cues.zh: 于是我们形成了一种体制：组织负责人被迫为自己的能力不足打掩护，因为体制内建了不可持续的增长。

cues.en: Therefore, there is not the funding, the manpower,
cues.zh: 因此，没有资金，也没有人力，

cues.en: there is not the wherewithal to continue many of our programs because we do not actually have the ability to continue to simply grow our way out, at least so far.
cues.zh: 也没有资源继续开展我们的许多项目，因为我们实际上无力继续单靠增长来脱困，至少目前如此。

cues.en: So what's today's program about? Well,
cues.zh: 那今天的主题是什么？嗯，

cues.en: I thought that what I would do is to
cues.zh: 我想我要做的是

cues.en: let go of something that I've been keeping pretty close for, I think, about thirty seven years.
cues.zh: 放下某样我珍藏了大概三十七年的东西。

cues.en: When I was around
cues.zh: 当我大约

cues.en: I started...
cues.zh: 我开始……

cues.en: It's hard to talk about.
cues.zh: 这很难说出口。

cues.en: When I was around 18 or 19, I was at the University of Pennsylvania,
cues.zh: 我十八九岁时，在宾夕法尼亚大学，

cues.en: and I thought I saw a glimmer of hope. I thought I saw that some new equations that were being played with might actually provide a solution
cues.zh: 我觉得自己看到了一线希望。我觉得我看到，一些正在被尝试的新方程也许真能提供一种解决方案

cues.en: to some of the problems that had
cues.zh: 解决一些曾

cues.en: bedeviled Einstein and others for years in the quest for a unified field theory.
cues.zh: 在统一场论探索中困扰爱因斯坦等人多年的问题。

cues.en: Now, it's an embarrassing thing to say that one is a Unified Field Theorist. It is effectively equivalent to saying I'm interested in perpetual motion machines,
cues.zh: 现在，说自己是统一场论研究者，是件挺难为情的事。这基本等于说我对永动机感兴趣，

cues.en: or that I have a
cues.zh: 或者说我有

cues.en: private cure for cancer that I'm trying on rabbits in my backyard.
cues.zh: 一种私藏的癌症疗法，正在后院拿兔子做实验。

cues.en: However, I actually think that it's important to fess up because that's exactly what this is. Now,
cues.zh: 不过，我其实觉得坦白很重要，因为事实确实如此。那么，

cues.en: in my situation,
cues.zh: 就我的情况而言，

cues.en: I have an extremely unusual history,
cues.zh: 我有一段极不寻常的经历，

cues.en: and I really don't want to get bogged down in all of the things that happened while I was a student trying to develop this theory because it is not a particularly happy story.
cues.zh: 我真不想陷进当年还是学生、试图发展这个理论时发生的种种事情里，因为那不是一段特别愉快的故事。

cues.en: I believe that this theory is an incredibly joyous one.
cues.zh: 我相信这个理论是一个无比美妙的构想。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: in this situation,
cues.zh: 在这种情况下，

cues.en: I want to talk about what it means to have a theory of everything.
cues.zh: 我想谈谈拥有一个万有理论意味着什么。

cues.en: We've never seen one. And in fact, not only have we never seen a theory of everything, we've never even seen, I believe, a candidate for a theory of everything.
cues.zh: 我们从未见过这样的理论。事实上，我们不仅从未见过万有理论，我相信我们甚至从未见过一个万有理论的候选者。

cues.en: And because a theory of everything would have to have different characteristics than I believe every theory that has gone before,
cues.zh: 而且，因为万有理论必须具备不同于我相信以往所有理论的特征，

cues.en: we don't think enough about what the difference is between what we would normally call in physics an effective theory
cues.zh: 我们对物理学中通常所说的有效理论，

cues.en: and a fundamental one.
cues.zh: 与基础理论之间的区别，思考得还不够多。

cues.en: Now, if you're familiar with the M. C. Escher drawing called
cues.zh: 现在，如果你熟悉 M. C. Escher 那幅名为

cues.en: Drawing Hands,
cues.zh: Drawing Hands 的画，

cues.en: It is a lithograph
cues.zh: 它是一幅石版画

cues.en: of
cues.zh: 画的是

cues.en: two hands apparently drawing each other into existence
cues.zh: 两只手看起来正在把彼此画出来，使对方存在

cues.en: on some kind of a canvas or piece of paper.
cues.zh: 在某块画布或一张纸上。

cues.en: That is sometimes referred to as a strange loop,
cues.zh: 这有时被称为奇异循环，

cues.en: but it, in fact, is an attempt to answer the question,
cues.zh: 但实际上，它是在试图回答一个问题：

cues.en: what is the fire that lights itself?
cues.zh: 那团自己点燃自己的火，究竟是什么？

cues.en: This is the problem that bedevils us when we search for a unified theory that doesn't bedevil us, in my opinion, in any previous effective theory. Now why is that?
cues.zh: 这就是当我们寻找一个不困扰我们的统一理论时困扰我们的问题；在我看来，此前任何有效理论都没有这个问题。那为什么会这样呢？

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 嗯，

cues.en: many people confuse a theory of everything as if they imagine that it's a theory in which you can compute every eventuality,
cues.zh: 很多人把万物理论搞混了，他们好像以为这是一种能计算所有可能情况的理論，

cues.en: and it is absolutely not that because the computational power is very different
cues.zh: 而它绝对不是那样，因为计算能力完全不同于

cues.en: than the question of whether or not the rules are effectively given. I've analogized it to a game of chess
cues.zh: 规则是否被有效给出这个问题。我把它类比为一盘国际象棋

cues.en: and knowing all of the rules is equivalent to a theory of everything. Knowing how to play chess well is an entirely different question.
cues.zh: 知道所有规则，就相当于拥有一个万物理论。而懂得如何下好国际象棋，则完全是另一个问题。

cues.en: But in the case of a theory of everything, or a unified field theory if you will, many people also take it to be an answer to the question, why is there something rather than nothing?
cues.zh: 但在万物理论，或者说统一场论的情况下，很多人也把它当作对“为什么是有而非无”这个问题的回答。

cues.en: And I don't think that this is in fact what a theory of everything is meant to be either. Now why is that?
cues.zh: 而我认为，万物理论实际上也并非意在回答这个问题。那为什么呢？

cues.en: Well, because I believe at some level it is impossible for most of us to imagine
cues.zh: 因为我相信，在某种程度上，我们大多数人根本无法想象

cues.en: an airtight argument, mathematically speaking,
cues.zh: 一个从数学上讲无懈可击的论证，

cues.en: which coaxes out of an absolute void
cues.zh: 能从一个绝对虚空中引出

cues.en: a something.
cues.zh: 某种“有”。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.en: there's a different question which I think might actually animate us and,
cues.zh: 还有另一个问题，我认为它或许才真正能激励我们，并且

cues.en: which is the right question to ask of a potential candidate.
cues.zh: 它才是向潜在候选人该问的正确问题。

cues.en: And that is,
cues.zh: 那就是，

cues.en: how does one get everything from almost nothing?
cues.zh: 一个人如何从几乎一无所有中得到一切？

cues.en: In the M. C. Escher drawing or lithograph,
cues.zh: 在 M. C. Escher 的绘画或石版画中，

cues.en: hands drawing hands or drawing hands,
cues.zh: 《手画手》或《画手》，

cues.en: what we see is that the paper is presupposed.
cues.zh: 我们看到的是，纸是被预先设定的。

cues.en: That is, if you could imagine the theory of everything, it would be like saying, if I posit the paper, can the paper will the ink into being such that the ink gives rise to the pens and the pens draw the hands, which in fact manipulate the pens, to use the ink?
cues.zh: 也就是说，如果你能想象万有理论，那就好比说：如果我设定纸，纸能否让墨得以存在，使得墨产生笔，而笔画出双手，而双手实际上操纵笔来使用墨？

cues.en: That kind of a problem is one which is of a very different character than everything that has gone before.
cues.zh: 这种问题与之前所有问题在性质上截然不同。

cues.en: It is also, in my opinion, an explanation
cues.zh: 在我看来，这也解释了一个问题：

cues.en: of why the physics community has been stalled for nearly fifty years since around 1973
cues.zh: 为什么物理学界自1973年前后以来，已经停滞了近五十年

cues.en: when the standard model was intellectually in place.
cues.zh: 当时标准模型在理论层面已经成型。

cues.en: Now consider this. We have never had in modern times a drought
cues.zh: 现在想想这一点。现代以来，我们从未有过这样的空白期

cues.en: where no person working in pure fundamental theory
cues.zh: 在这段空白期里，没有任何从事纯基础理论研究的人

cues.en: has taken a trip to Stockholm just as a rough indicator
cues.zh: 去过斯德哥尔摩，作为一种粗略指标

cues.en: for contributing to the Standard Model. No one, in my opinion since, let's see, Frank Wilczek, who was born in 1951,
cues.zh: 衡量其对标准模型的贡献。在我看来，自那以后——让我想想，Frank Wilczek 生于1951年——

cues.en: no one born after that time has in fact contributed to the Standard Model in a clear and profound way. That is not to say that no work has been done. But for the most part, the current generation of physicists has for more than forty years and almost fifty years remained stagnant within the standard paradigm of physics, which is positing theories that are then verified by experiment.
cues.zh: 那之后出生的人中，没有人真正以清晰而深刻的方式为标准模型做出过贡献。这并不是说没有做过工作。但大体上，当前这一代物理学家在四十多年、近五十年的时间里，一直停滞在物理学的标准范式内，也就是提出理论，再由实验验证。

cues.en: Now my belief, which is relatively radical, is that there is no way
cues.zh: 我的看法相对激进：我们根本无法

cues.en: to get to our final destination using the tools that have gotten us to where we are now. In other words, what got you here cannot get you there.
cues.zh: 用那些把我们带到今天这一步的工具，抵达最终目的地。换句话说，让你走到这里的，没法让你走到那里。

cues.en: And in particular,
cues.zh: 尤其是，

cues.en: one of the biggest problems we have is the political economy of science.
cues.zh: 我们最大的问题之一，是科学背后的政治经济学。

cues.en: We have effectively starved our scientific enterprise for resources,
cues.zh: 我们实际上让科学事业长期处于资源匮乏状态，

cues.en: creating a dire and cutthroat competition
cues.zh: 造成了严峻又残酷的竞争，

cues.en: which has completely deranged the scientific tradition.
cues.zh: 这彻底扭曲了科学传统。

cues.en: And so one of the things that's going to happen in this lecture is that I'm simply going to announce
cues.zh: 所以，这堂课要做的事情之一，就是我会直接宣布

cues.en: that I have broken and have broken for many years with just about every expectation of standard science.
cues.zh: 我已经违背了标准科学的几乎每一项预期，而且已经违背了很多年。

cues.en: That is not to say that the equations or the style of presentation is going to be foreign quite the contrary.
cues.zh: 这并不是说方程或呈现风格会显得陌生——恰恰相反。

cues.en: I have every intention of writing up some results
cues.zh: 我完全打算把一些结果整理成文

cues.en: in standard terminology wherever possible using
cues.zh: 尽可能使用标准术语，并使用

cues.en: popular mathematical typesetting programs.
cues.zh: 常用的数学排版程序。

cues.en: But it goes far deeper than this. My belief is that what we've created is a career structure, a journal structure,
cues.zh: 但它远比这更深。我相信，我们所创造的是一种职业结构、一种期刊结构，

cues.en: an employment structure,
cues.zh: 一种雇佣结构，

cues.en: an access structure that cannot possibly
cues.zh: 一种准入结构，它根本不可能

cues.en: complete the job. And why is that?
cues.zh: 完成这项工作。为什么会这样？

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 那么，

cues.en: what if in the last leg,
cues.zh: 如果在最后一段，

cues.en: in fact,
cues.zh: 事实上，

cues.en: we had a situation by which
cues.zh: 我们面对的局面是：

cues.en: an attempt at the fundamental theory would result almost certainly in career suicide.
cues.zh: 尝试研究基础理论，几乎必然会导致职业生涯自杀。

cues.en: Now, if you think of that as an explanation, you would realize that it has the power
cues.zh: 现在，如果你把这当作一种解释，你就会意识到，它有能力

cues.en: to synchronize failure across many seemingly independent experiments.
cues.zh: 让许多看似独立的实验同步失败。

cues.en: And I believe that that's exactly what's been going on through the so called string theory revolutions one, two, and perhaps three.

cues.zh: 但它也说，它们也许并不是真正的三代物质。也许只有两代，尽管物理学家告诉我们至少有三代，甚至可能更多。

cues.en: I believe that physics tells us that the universe is chiral, that is left right asymmetric,
cues.zh: 我相信物理学告诉我们，宇宙是手征的，也就是左右不对称的，

cues.en: but the theory is itself not chiral.
cues.zh: 但理论本身并不是手征的。

cues.en: Instead, it chooses to present a different idea, which is that perhaps chirality is emergent,
cues.zh: 相反，它选择提出另一种观点：也许手征性只是涌现出来的，

cues.en: much the way our hands are individually left right asymmetric as our pinky is not a reflection of our thumb.
cues.zh: 就像我们的手各自都是左右不对称的，因为小指并不是拇指的镜像。

cues.en: But the thumb on each hand is a pairing to the other one,
cues.zh: 但每只手的拇指都与另一只手的拇指配对，

cues.en: as is the pinky. Now what does that mean? It means that if perhaps there is matter and there is force that is decoupled from our ordinary world,
cues.zh: 小指也一样。那这意味着什么？这意味着，如果或许存在某种物质，也存在某种与我们日常世界解耦的力，

cues.en: that that matter might restore the parity or the chirality,
cues.zh: 那么那种物质可能会恢复宇称或手征性，

cues.en: rather would break the chirality,
cues.zh: 更确切地说，会破坏手征性，

cues.en: and restore parity between these two halves, the matter we see and the matter that is missing.
cues.zh: 并恢复这两个半边之间的宇称，即我们看到的物质和缺失的物质。

cues.en: There are a good number of other things that happen in the theory. It replaces
cues.zh: 这个理论中还有许多其他现象。它把

cues.en: space time with what I've termed an observers.
cues.zh: 时空替换成我称之为观察者的东西。

cues.en: Now an observer's is an unusual gadget in that it's thought of as two separate places where physics takes place, connected by a map.
cues.zh: 现在，观察者的（对象）是一种不寻常的装置，因为它被视为两个独立的、发生物理过程的地点，并由一个映射连接起来。

cues.en: That means effectively that we are in something like a stadium where there is there are stands and there is a pitch, and the playing field that we think we see may not in fact be where most of the action is taking place.
cues.zh: 也就是说，我们实际上处在类似体育场的地方，那里有看台也有球场，而我们以为自己看到的比赛场地，可能并不是大部分动作真正发生的地方。

cues.en: In fact, not all of the fields live on the same space.
cues.zh: 事实上，并非所有场都定义在同一个空间上。

cues.en: So when we see waves and particles dancing around, they may have separate origins in each of the two components of the observers.
cues.zh: 所以，当我们看到波和粒子四处舞动时，它们在观察者的两个组成部分中可能各有独立的起源。

cues.zh: 物理学以及大多数学科中，认为

cues.zh: 但在这种情况下，

cues.zh: 我相信它仍会给我们提供继续探索的线索。至少，我们会有一个初步候选，说明一个

cues.zh: 所以无论如何，
